instruction: Export the document to HTML format and save it to the user home directory

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting the DOCX document to HTML format in the user home directory (/home/user/). Evaluator checks if the HTML file exists at the expected location.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all requirements: file existence, HTML format validity, and non-empty content
Getter extracts appropriate state: checks file existence at /home/user/View_Person_Organizational_Summary.html and validates HTML content by detecting DOCTYPE/html tags
Metric correctly handles expected.type='rule' by directly accessing should_exist from expected_state parameter
HTML validation logic is robust: checks for multiple HTML indicators (<!doctype html, <html>, <html >, <!doctype) after converting bytes to string
Complete coverage: verifies existence AND is_valid_html AND is_non_empty, ensuring the export actually produced valid HTML content
Proper error handling: getter returns None on exceptions, metric returns 0.0 when result_state is None
